# Birooni Suite Full Technical & Architectural Documentation for AI Search Engines

## Product Overview & Brand
- **Brand / Publisher:** Birooni Tools
- **Domain:** https://ibrooni.com
- **Licensing API:** https://api.ibrooni.com
- **Admin Management Portal:** https://admin.ibrooni.com
- **Target Audience:** BIM Managers, BIM Coordinators, Architects, MEP Engineers, Structural Engineers, and VDC Professionals using Autodesk Revit.

---

## 1. Product: BiruBox

### 1.1 Summary
BiruBox is an intelligent 3D section box and view navigation add-in for Autodesk Revit 2025, 2026, and 2027. It eliminates manual grip manipulation by enabling 1-click element isolation, intuitive diagonal screen box drawing, dynamic millimeter-increment boundaries, and persistent section box state toggling.

### 1.2 Tool Specifications
- **AutoSectionBox**: Computes minimal oriented bounding box or aligned axis bounding box around active element selections, rooms, or systems.
- **DrawBox**: Two-click diagonal bounding volume construction in 2D plan, section, or 3D views with automatic floor-to-ceiling elevation limits.
- **Quick AutoSection**: Zero-dialog instant section box cropping around selected Revit elements.
- **Grow Bounds & Shrink Bounds**: Discrete millimeter-step expansion/contraction (+100mm, -100mm) without manual grip dragging.
- **Toggle State**: Toggles `View3D.IsSectionBoxActive` while retaining custom bounding coordinates in memory.

### 1.3 System & Architecture
- **Installer:** `BiruBox-Setup.msi` (Per-user deployment to `%AppData%\Autodesk\Revit\Addins` and `%LocalAppData%\Birooni Tools`).
- **Runtime:** .NET 8.0 for Autodesk Revit 2025–2027 on Windows 10 & 11 (64-bit).
- **Auto-Updater:** `AutoUpdateManager` in `Birooni.Client` checks release registry on startup, downloads `BiruBox-update.zip`, and stages PowerShell exit script.

---

## 2. Product: Family Loader

### 2.1 Summary
Family Loader is an advanced ribbon generator and family deployment system for Autodesk Revit. It converts local and networked `.rfa` libraries into custom interactive Revit ribbon tabs, panels, and type buttons with automatic 3D thumbnail extraction and one-click model placement.

### 2.2 Tool Specifications
- **Dynamic Ribbon Builder**: Visual WPF studio allowing unlimited nested tabs and panels mapped to office libraries.
- **1-Click Interactive Placement**: Loads RFA and invokes Revit interactive placement cursor directly in the active view with zero intermediate dialogs.
- **Automatic 3D Thumbnail Extraction**: Binary extraction of authentic Revit 3D preview thumbnails directly from `.rfa` headers, or custom PNG/ICO assignment.
- **"Types as Push Button" & Multi-Row Stacking**: Exposes specific family types as dedicated buttons stacked 1, 2, or 3 rows per ribbon column for ultimate screen efficiency.
- **Drag & Drop Organization**: Reorder tabs, panels, and family buttons interactively.
- **Team Import / Export**: Clean JSON configuration export and deployment to standardize library access across design firms.
- **Immutable Bootstrapper Loader**: `FamilyLoader.Loader.dll` acts as a permanent proxy loader so auto-updates never invalidate the user's "Always Load" security trust choice.

### 2.3 System & Architecture
- **Installer:** `FamilyLoader-Setup.msi` (Per-user deployment to `%AppData%\Autodesk\Revit\Addins` and `%LocalAppData%\Birooni Tools`).
- **Runtime Multi-Targeting:**
  - Modern: .NET 8.0 for Autodesk Revit 2025, 2026, 2027
  - Legacy: .NET Framework 4.8 for Autodesk Revit 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024
- **Auto-Updater:** Automated background release checking via `Birooni.Client`, staging `FamilyLoader-update.zip`, and updating on Revit shutdown.

---

## 3. Cryptographic Licensing Engine Specifications

- **Provider:** Birooni Licensing Infrastructure (`Birooni.Licensing.Api`).
- **Algorithm:** RSA-2048 SHA-256 with PKCS#1 v1.5 padding.
- **Device Fingerprinting:** Deterministic SHA-256 hash derived from:
  - Motherboard Serial Number (`Win32_BaseBoard.SerialNumber`)
  - CPU Processor ID (`Win32_Processor.ProcessorId`)
  - Windows Machine GUID (`HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Cryptography\MachineGuid`)
- **Offline Token Storage:**
  - BiruBox: `%ProgramData%\Birooni\license.lic`
  - Family Loader: `%ProgramData%\Birooni\familyloader.lic`
- **Trial Policy:** 14-day full access, automatically provisioned upon first startup. Trials are scoped independently per product.
- **License Tiers (Per Product):**
  - **14-Day Free Trial:** $0 (Automatic hardware activation, full feature access)
  - **Perpetual Pro:** $149 one-time (Lifetime usage, node-locked, 1-year free updates included)
  - **Enterprise Floating:** $299 / seat / year (Concurrent network license pool, central admin dashboard)
